source: The owner's plate_export.3mf: the six supp_ref heads (one object each) saved by Bambu Studio 02.09.01.70 (Bambu PLA Basic @BBL A1M, 0.20mm Standard @BBL A1M, tree(auto)), meshes inline in 3D/3dmodel.model. The owner's reference for what NSO's plate export is; its slice, plate_export.gcode.3mf, labels each head with its own OBJECT_ID. The earlier template, project_test.3mf (Studio 02.08.02.61, split 3D/Objects parts), stays beside it for the print path (app-print.js). nso-3mf.js writes its envelope; see docs/BAMBU-PROJECT-EXPORT.md.
